interval_rule: Transpose DOWN a Perfect 4th (or read in Bass Clef + 8ve)
clef_reading_method: Read in bass clef one octave up; add one sharp / subtract one flat.
canonical_repertoire: Haydn Early Symphonies; Mozart Symphonies 36 & 41; Beethoven Symphony No. 1

clef_reading_method: Read in tenor clef, add three sharps (or subtract three flats).
canonical_repertoire: Beethoven Symphony No. 2; Haydn Concerto in D; Mozart Horn Concerto No. 4 Romance

interval_rule: Transpose DOWN a Major 2nd (One Whole Step)
clef_reading_method: Read in bass clef one octave higher, or read down one step; add two sharps / minus two flats.
canonical_repertoire: Beethoven Symphony No. 3 (Eroica); Mozart Concertos 1–4; Beethoven Symphony No. 5

interval_rule: Transpose DOWN a Minor 2nd (One Half Step)
clef_reading_method: Shift down one half-step; think one semitone lower throughout.
canonical_repertoire: Beethoven Symphony No. 7; Brahms Horn Trio Op. 40; Weber Der Freischütz Overture

clef_reading_method: Standard modern treble clef; play as written.
canonical_repertoire: Tchaikovsky Symphony No. 5; Mahler Symphonies; Richard Strauss Tone Poems

interval_rule: Transpose UP a Major 2nd (One Whole Step)
clef_reading_method: Read in alto clef; add two sharps / subtract two flats.
canonical_repertoire: Mozart Symphony No. 40; Rossini William Tell; Haydn Surprise Symphony

clef_reading_method: Read up a major third directly on treble clef; add four sharps.
canonical_repertoire: Beethoven Symphony No. 7 Finale; Mozart Symphony No. 29; Mendelssohn Symphony No. 4

clef_reading_method: Read up a perfect 4th; play directly on B♭ tube harmonic nodes.
canonical_repertoire: Mozart Symphony No. 25 in G minor; Haydn Symphony No. 39; Schumann Symphony No. 2

clef_reading_method: Read down a perfect 5th; typical in low pedal register.
canonical_repertoire: Brahms Symphony No. 2; Beethoven Symphony No. 4; Haydn Symphony No. 98
